item.title: New Hitec RDX4 Mini 100W AC Battery Charger
item.description: Hitec's RDX4 Mini is our latest innovation in radio control battery charging technology designed for the discerning RC enthusiasts. This compact yet powerful charger is set to revolutionize the way you power your devices.

item.title: New VP-Pro Universal 1/8th Scale Body
item.description: VP-Pro is excited to announce their universal body shell CB-8021 for 1/8th scale buggy chassis.

item.title: Industry Analytics: Weekly Stats [1/14 - 1/21]
item.description: This week over 19,900 entries were tallied in the #LiveTimeScoring system across all the rc racing genres. 1/10th scale off-road lead the way ahead of dirt oval and electric on-road. #IndustryAnalytics

item.title: New Hudy 1/8th Off-Road Tire Gluing Jig and Case
item.description: The HUDY Tire Gluing Jig for 1/8 Off-Road is a premium device designed for both hobbyists and professional drivers to glue rubber tires to wheels in a quick & secure way.

item.title: New Team Associated RC10 4wd Pickup Truck Kit
item.description: This RC10 4wd Pickup Truck kit is designed not only for scale looks with realistic wheels, tires and body, this truck is built for performance as well. The steel ladder frame chassis provides the perfect backbone for this rugged little rig.

item.title: New Sota RC 1/10th Scale Off-Road Pistons
item.description: SOTA is proud to introduce a new benchmark in RC shock piston design. At a glance it may look unconventional, but this piston delivers a level of damping control and tuning depth previously reserved for full-scale motorsport — now in RC.

item.title: Building Differentials With Jacob Hardison [VIDEO]
item.description: Check out some tips and tricks with Adrenaline RC's Jacob Hardison on how he builds and does maintenance on differentials.

item.title: New VP-Pro Touring Car Tire Bands
item.description: VP-Pro has added extra small size version to their tire mounting band group. Specifically designed for holding tires down during the gluing process for touring car tires.

item.title: New Hong-Nor X5B Aluminum Front Top Deck
item.description: Hong Nor has released a new 7075-T6 CNC front top deck for the X5B, which reduces body twist and improves cornering stability.

item.title: New ALF1 Carbon Fiber Damper Plate and Battery Mount
item.description: ALF1 has released a new carbon fiber Battery Mount as well as carbon fiber Damper Plate.
